name: car_exit
text: Sitting in a low car driver seat, open the door with the left hand. Turn the body sideways, place the left foot outside on the ground, bring the right leg out, lean forward and stand up beside the car. Finish upright with both feet on the ground.

scene.description: Start at car_interactive.post_carexit facing the model standing marker direction. Sitting in a low car driver seat, open the door with the left hand.
